lines: She lifts eleven feet. That is the whole village in one number.
Everything you are standing on is below the water behind me. Every inch of it.
You are welcome to come in and look. Everybody does it once and then never forgets it.
Look up at the drain. Now look at my roof. Go on, both.
Sixty-one years I have slept under water and not one night wondered about it.
You do not worry about the bank. You worry about the man who watches the bank.
When the engine stops in the night everybody wakes up.
Not because it is loud. Because it is not.
Two loads a week to Harrowgate and it goes on a train from there.
It used to go all the way to the capital by road and take me four days.
I am not sorry. I have got my evenings back and my horse is eleven.
You came up the road from the mire? Then you have seen what we used to be.
My great-grandmother was born in a reed house and died in a brick one, half a mile apart.
Somebody dug a ditch. That is the entire difference and it is the whole difference.
The clinic is at the end of the row. It is small and it is open.
It is open because the road goes past and the road does not keep hours.
